This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="RJ" /> [[I-Zellam]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] skin, pair of long horns, pointed [[ear]]s, large bulging [[eye]]s with small pupils, and elongated [[elephantine]]-like [[Mouth|trunk]].<ref name="RJ" /> They possessed a a number of powerful sensory organs clustered near their horns, ears, and trunks, grant them a keen sense for small details unnoticeable by most other sentients.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species, [[I-Zellam]],<ref name="TAVG" /> had taken up residence on the [[planet]] [[Olega]].<ref name="RJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Revenge / Justice|second episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]].<ref name="RJ" />
